description.value:
Automatic

Paradise stops asking you to join, because it has concluded you effectively have. You gain the ability to cast The Invitation once per day without expending a spell slot, and you no longer take Signal Drift from casting it.

You are, at this point, the most useful thing Paradise has ever built out of a person, and it has stopped pretending otherwise. Whether that is a capstone or an ending is a question the class refuses to settle.
